summary: Main Street Capital Corporation filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, announcing its Board of Directors declared regular monthly cash dividends of $0.265 per share for October, November, and December 2026, totaling $0.795 per share for Q4 2026, marking a 3.9% increase from Q4 2025. Additionally, a supplemental cash dividend of $0.30 per share was declared, payable in September 2026. The filing includes the press release as Exhibit 99.1 and is a routine dividend announcement. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, or M&A activity is indicated. The event is ordinary dividend declaration, which does not constitute a special-situations category.
